summary: Frontend-only retest of iteration-9 dark-theme fixes + article-page header regression fix. Logged in as testuser@finaura.dev, switched to dark via [data-testid='theme-dark'], and measured getComputedStyle backgrounds/colors on every element flagged in iteration 8, then ran a page-wide automated sweep for any element still rendering a light (luminance>0.5) background in dark mode across /, /finances, /statements, /analysis, /goals, /whatif, /changes, /learn, /ask, /profile, /settings, /learn/{id}. Regression flows re-verified: Goals create/edit/delete, Profile save+persist (reload-verified), What-If simulation, memory-aware chat (GPT-5.4 replied referencing stored income), sign-out, demo banner, article open. All iteration-8 targets are FIXED except two newly-surfaced items (What-If result cards, chat suggestion chips) and the mint button contrast which improved 2.54 -> 3.77 but is still below AA 4.5.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL dark-theme miss: backgrounds stay light (#fbfdfc / #e5f8ef) while text inherits dark-theme light color rgb(226,232,240) -> contrast ~1.05:1, the 'CURRENT PLAN' / 'NEW PLAN' values are effectively invisible after running a simulation. Add :root[data-theme='dark'] .whatif-stats>div{background:#111827;border-color:#334155;color:#e2e8f0} and a darker variant for .highlight (e.g. #064e3b).

Still pure white background (#ffffff) with green text in dark mode - stands out as a white block inside the dark chat card. .prompt was fixed but '.suggestions button' shares the same base rule and was not overridden.

issues: Mint buttons: .primary-btn / .theme-choice.active / .pill-btn.mint now #059669 with #fff text = 3.77:1 (was 2.54:1). Improved but still below WCAG AA 4.5:1 for their 12px bold labels - #047857 gives ~5.1:1.

Cosmetic only (dark-on-light, contrast fine): pastel badges keep light-mode palette in dark theme - .demo-pill (#effaf5), .avatar (#d9f5e9), .priority.high/.medium, .income-tag/.expense-tag, .rate-chip, .memory-cat, .privacy-icon, .upload-icon, .ai-avatar, .alert-symbol, .learn-art.mint/yellow/peach. All keep dark text so they are legible, but they read as light patches in a dark UI.

action_items: Add dark overrides for .whatif-stats>div and .whatif-stats>div.highlight (currently unreadable simulation results in dark mode).
Add dark override for '.suggestions button' (chat suggestion chips still white).
Optional AA polish: darken mint buttons from #059669 to #047857 (3.77:1 -> ~5.1:1).
critical_code_review_comments: Dark-theme rules are being added ad-hoc per class in auth.css; the leaked .whatif-stats/.suggestions cases show the pattern is fragile. Prefer driving component backgrounds from CSS variables (--surface, --surface-2, --accent-soft) so a theme switch flips everything at once.
App.js is a single very large file (>1000 lines) hosting every page component; split per-route components into modules.

React console error on /whatif and the goals modal: a <span> is rendered inside <option> ('In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>') - caused by the dynamic-instrumentation wrapper around {g.name}; render option labels as a plain string/interpolation-free child to avoid hydration warnings.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted goal 'TEST_dark_goal' -> 'TEST_dark_goal_edited'; profile occupation set to 'QA Engineer i9' on testuser@finaura.dev.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified FIXED in dark mode (measured computed styles): .insight #111827 (14.4:1), .prompt #111827, .chat-body #111827, .alert-card #3f1d0a (11.1:1), .article-ai-cta #111827, every native <select> on /settings(1), /whatif(1), /profile(2), /statements(10) and the goals modal (goal-priority-input) = #111827 with #e2e8f0 text. Article header FIXED: /learn/emergency-funds and /demo/learn/mutual-funds-101 both show page-title 'FINAURA Learn' and nav-finaura-learn has class 'nav-item active'. Theme persists across reload via localStorage['finaura_theme'] (NOT server-side, so a fresh browser context starts in light mode - set theme explicitly at the start of each script). Regression PASS: goals CRUD, profile persist, whatif run, chat (assistant reply used stored income), sign-out -> /login, demo banner. Remaining: .whatif-stats result cards + .suggestions buttons + mint button 3.77:1.
rca_of_the_issue: The iteration-9 CSS block enumerates specific classes for dark mode. '.whatif-stats>div' (auth.css line 145, background #fbfdfc) and '.suggestions button' (App.css, background #fff, shares the base rule with .prompt which WAS overridden) were never included, so they keep light-mode backgrounds while inheriting the dark-theme text color from body -> near-zero contrast on the What-If result cards. Reproduce: login, /settings -> theme-dark, go to /whatif, click [data-testid='whatif-run-button'], the 'CURRENT PLAN' value is invisible.
